name: fixture loads no longer abort archive.org images
why: Without the route, page.goto() waits for the saved page's live Internet Archive thumbnail; when archive.org stalls, the fixture load times out before the userscript is injected.
grep: never waits on an archive.org image

name: the pattern also swallows coverartarchive.org
why: CAA specs register their coverartarchive.org mocks before loadUserscriptPage(); the helper's newer route would then abort their images.

name: the art archives' images are not blocked during the load
why: A coverartarchive.org thumbnail in the fixture's markup redirects to archive.org, a hop no route sees: page.goto() waits on the Internet Archive again (filter-autofocus.spec.js timed out this way, 2026-10-14).
grep: never waits on a coverartarchive.org thumbnail

name: the art-archive block outlives the load
why: Every later coverartarchive.org/eventartarchive.org image is aborted too, so a CAA spec's own mock is never reached.
